summary_en: ¥20.0B upper limit, 7,000,000 shares (4.6% of shares outstanding), market purchase via investment discretionary contract with TSE, execution window 26 Aug 2026 – 25 Aug 2027, to enhance capital efficiency under Medium-Term Management Plan 2030 shareholder return policy.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares (Acquisition of Treasury Shares Based on the Provisions of the Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 165(2) of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: On 5 August 2026, Toyo Seikan Group Holdings resolved by board resolution to initiate a treasury share acquisition program. The program is authorized to acquire up to 7,000,000 ordinary shares (4.6% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an aggregate maximum of ¥20.0 billion. The acquisition will be executed via market purchase using an investment discretionary contract with the Tokyo Stock Exchange (ToSTNeT-3 method), over the period 26 August 2026 to 25 August 2027. The rationale is to enhance capital efficiency pursuant to the shareholder return policy outlined in the Medium-Term Management Plan 2030, announced on 14 May 2026. At 30 June 2026, the company held 2,110,273 treasury shares and had 151,051,889 shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock).
